templates.name: New external document
templates.description: Process a new or changed Drive/Dropbox/Airtable document through catalog, evidence, Contacts and Accounting.

templates.name: New local evidence
templates.description: Process newly preserved local evidence through Library indexing, Contacts and Accounting.

templates.name: New statement or bill
templates.description: Preserve, index and extract accounting/contact facts from a verified statement or bill.

templates.name: New invoice or receipt
templates.description: File, index and stage verified invoice/receipt evidence for bookkeeping.

templates.name: New contact evidence
templates.description: Extract and reconcile verified identity/contact facts while preserving provenance.

templates.name: Released mail processing
templates.description: Run Contacts extraction, document filing and accounting intake after a message is safely released.

templates.name: Automation health recovery
templates.description: Attempt bounded self-healing and recheck automation health before escalation.

templates.name: Spamhaus recovery
templates.description: Run the existing bounded Spamhaus maintenance action and escalate only after retry exhaustion.

templates.name: Suricata recovery
templates.description: Run the existing bounded Suricata maintenance action and escalate only after retry exhaustion.

templates.name: Executive reporting cycle
templates.description: Verify evidence and backup posture, then refresh daily/weekly executive reports.

templates.name: Missing expected financial document
templates.description: Open an AVA review item when an expected recurring statement/invoice period is missing; do not fabricate or fetch credentials.

templates.name: Website/content change
templates.description: Prepare a bounded change workflow once a website deployment capability is registered with AVA.
